species.real: Harry Brearley was trying to make rifle barrels that wore out more slowly when he noticed his test samples refused to rust on the scrap heap.
species.name: Cutlet

dex.text: A bit of a show-off with a bright edge, which it sharpens on anything within reach. Lives close to the furnaces and has never once been cold.
dex.fact: Stainless steel was invented in Sheffield in 1913, and the city became famous for it.

species.real: Sheffield's cutlers' guild, the Company of Cutlers in Hallamshire, was founded in 1624 and is still going.
species.name: Steelheart

dex.text: Forged, quenched and polished until it could cut a rope, a rumour or a bad argument. Never rusts, which is more than can be said for most of its relatives.
dex.fact: Stainless steel resists rust thanks to chromium, which forms a thin protective layer on the surface.
